title: Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics
description: Applications of quantum physics to atomic and molecular structure. Interaction of atoms with static and oscillating electromagnetic fields. Near-resonant coherent light-atom interactions and laser spectroscopy. Optical manipulation of atoms and molecules. Laser cooling, optical tweezers and degenerate ultracold matter.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PHYS 313, PHYS 413A, PHYS 413B.
Students are advised to consult the department to determine when the course is offered.
